pairs.difference: A: rocking chair on wide, quiet wood planks against a blue striped wall. The stripes are even and there is no hotspot. B: bloodhound on a grass floor made of thousands of fine blades, and the striped wall has a bright cyan glow sitting right behind the dog's back. The generated lessons (glove, camera) show the same centred halo.
pairs.fix: Plain blue vertical-stripe wall with even tone and no glow behind the dog; a short, soft grass floor drawn as a few broad green shapes, not individual blades.

pairs.difference: A: graduation cap on blue concentric rings. B: fedora on green concentric rings. Both are category 1 on a quiet tone-on-tone ring field with a slightly lighter centre, and neither has props or decoration. Nothing on my vector separates them.

A: gas pump on a concrete pad cut by the card edge, with soft desert mesas behind. That is a few large quiet shapes. B: open chest on a sand mound underwater. Its coins and gems are fine because the chest holds them, but it adds a seashell at the lower left, loose coins rolling in front, and about ten bubbles across the backdrop. The lighthouse lessons show the same kind of invented scatter (rope, lifebuoy, plants).
pairs.fix: Treasure chest on a plain sand floor under calm blue water, with coins and gems only inside the chest. No seashell, no loose coins on the sand, at most two or three soft bubbles.

pairs.difference: A: typewriter on a dark desk with the front edge showing, in front of an orange harlequin wall. This matches the real computer card's desk staging. B: popcorn cart on a pale cobblestone floor against a blue diamond wall, plus a popcorn bucket, which is a plausible partner object. The cobbles are busier (0.041) but still within the real range. Neither card is clearly off.

A: door set into a plain cyan wall with a tile floor and baseboard. That is a few metres of the place in large, quiet shapes. B: the door is framed by dense ivy, with dozens of separate leaves down both sides and across the top, plus a flower wreath. Its background edge density is 0.107, above the top of the real range (0.089). This matches the generated lighthouses gaining plants and clutter.
pairs.fix: Blue front door in a plain warm plaster wall with a simple wooden frame. No ivy or leaves around the door. Keep the wall as one calm colour.

pairs.difference: A: street lamp on an even teal sunburst with no hotspot, cut by the bottom edge. B: bellows camera floating on a cyan sunburst with a strong white-cyan glow behind the box. The generated glove and camera lessons have the same bright halo.
pairs.fix: Even blue sunburst with the rays the same brightness all the way to the centre, and no glow behind the camera.

pairs.difference: A: oil lamp on a green-yellow sunburst. B: magnifier on a blue sunburst. Both are category 1 with a lighter centre and no props, and both detail values are in range. Nothing on my vector separates them.

A: sneakers on a pale yellow floor that meets an orange wall at a hard horizontal line, about halfway up. In a real category 2 card the floor is the backdrop's own colour (green suitcase floor on a green wall). B: safe on a seamless pink floor that blends into the pink wall, which matches the real cards.
pairs.fix: Sneakers on a plain floor the same orange as the wall, blending softly into it, with no hard horizon line and no second floor colour.

pairs.difference: A: boxing gloves on a wood shelf against blue vertical planks, cropped at the left edge. B: rotary phone on a dark desk with the front edge showing, against an orange striped wall. Both are close category 3 stagings with quiet backdrops and both values are in range.

A: a flat shield lies at an angle on a plain purple gradient with no material and no pattern. Background detail is 0.0048, below the real range of 0.008 to 0.013. A real flat object lies on a surface that fills the card. B: vending machine on a seamless purple floor and wall, a standard category 2 card.
pairs.fix: Shield lying flat on a surface that fills the whole card, seen from above, such as a soft purple fabric or painted wood with a broad, gentle grain.

pairs.difference: A: bottle on a yellow sunburst. B: ticket on orange vertical stripes. Both are category 1 graphic fields that are tone-on-tone and quiet, with no props. Nothing separates them on my vector.

A: journal on a tabletop painted as broad, stylised orange wood stripes. B: folder on dark wood with fine, photo-like grain across the whole card. Its background detail is 0.0292, well above the real maximum of 0.021. The real cards paint materials as a few soft bands, not fine grain.
pairs.fix: Folder lying on a warm brown wooden table painted as a few wide, soft grain bands in a simple cartoon style, with no fine photo-like wood texture.

pattern: Generated cards still give themselves away through the background. They put a bright glow behind the hero on graphic fields, add props the subject doesn't name (seashells, loose coins, bubbles, ivy, rocks, ropes), and paint materials with fine, photo-like grain or blade-level texture instead of a few broad, quiet shapes. They also show the whole object rather than letting the card edge crop the place it sits in.
